name: Clearcart
summary: A complete admin for a small online shop, in iPhone-style liquid glass with light and dark themes
about: A seven-page admin for a small online jewellery shop, built from frosted, liquid glass panels over a drawn aurora. Today's sales fill a liquid orb towards the daily target, new orders drop in live and a small island at the top stretches to announce them. Orders, products, customers, analytics, discount codes and settings all work with sample data.
how: Watch Home: the orb fills to today's target, visitors tick live and a new order arrives every few seconds.
Switch the revenue chart between 7D, 30D and 12M and the line morphs to the new range.
Open an order to follow its timeline, then mark it packed, shipped with a courier reference, delivered or cancelled.
On Products, flip the glass switch to show or hide a piece, nudge stock with plus and minus, or switch grid and list.
Create discount codes as glass tickets, turn them on and off and see how often each is used.
In Settings, drag the Frost slider to change how strong the glass blur is, edit delivery zones and payment options, or reset the demo data.
